decision.explanation: The question asks for sports teams represented by Sid Hoad. Document D2 states 'Sid Hoad... was an English footballer who played as a forward for various clubs, including Blackpool F.C.' (D2S2) and provides multiple citations confirming his tenure there (D2S8-D2S23). Both documents positively assign Sid Hoad to these respective teams, satisfying the request for all represented teams without contradiction or irrelevance.
